input.prompt: Create one continuous exactly 10 second seamless looping title background for the cozy 2D game Forest Patrol. Preserve the original flat hand-drawn forest storybook art, dark forest green outlines, muted botanical greens and warm cream yellow, three-quarter overhead game view, restrained three-tone shading, soft contact shadows. Reserve upper and lower areas for HTML menus; keep the cat in its original middle location. All motion must be real localized organic motion, not whole-image zooming, shaking, stretching or rotation. No new characters, no extra limbs, no face redesign, no realistic fur, no 3D, no dramatic lighting, no explosions, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no logo, no UI.
